title: Both Sides Brawl
topic: Equations with variables on both sides

scenes.say: Welcome back to Math Blitz! Day two, and you crushed yesterday. Today x shows up on both sides. It's a Both Sides Brawl!

scenes.heading: THE MATCHUP
scenes.note: Rule one: get all the x's on ONE side first.
scenes.say: Seven x plus two equals three x plus twenty six. X on both sides! Rule one: round up every x on one side.

scenes.heading: MOVE 1: SEND 3x PACKING
scenes.say: Move one! Subtract three x from both sides. Take away the smaller x term. Now it's four x plus two equals twenty six.

scenes.heading: MOVE 2: BALANCE TRICK
scenes.say: Now it's yesterday's Balance Trick! Subtract two, four x equals twenty four, x equals six. Check it. Both sides hit forty four. Swish!

scenes.ask: What is the value of x?
scenes.say: Your turn, champ! Twenty five XP on the line. Five x plus nine equals two x minus twelve. Watch those negatives! What is x? Tap your answer below the video!

question.prompt: 5x + 9 = 2x − 12. What is the value of x?
question.explain: Subtract 2x from both sides: 3x + 9 = −12. Subtract 9: 3x = −21, so x = −7. Check: 5(−7) + 9 = −26 and 2(−7) − 12 = −26.

trap_notes.0: Right steps, but lost the negative sign
trap_notes.3: Added 2x to both sides instead of subtracting (7x = −21)

rapid.prompt: Arcade A: $24 to get in + $3 a game. Arcade B: $7 a game. After how many games do they cost the same?

rapid.why: 4x = 24, so 2x = 12 and 2x + 1 = 13. Answer the question they asked!
